avis.texte: Very happy with this cleanser. It feels smooth and cleanses my face. Have used Clarins products for over 25 years and I have always been happy with their products
This is my favorite cleanser. It leaves my face looking smooth and feeling clean. No irritation.

I finally finished my last reserves of the older green cleansing milk for normal to dry skin, and was hoping this would be an easy transition. But upon using, it's so much stickier, felt like it left an film and it made my skin break out within a day. I hate when your favorite products go away and their replaced with something that feels worse. Now I'll have to change face wash brands after 17 years sadly.
I love this facial milk cleanser. My makeup comes off and leaves my skin like silk!

This facial milk feels incredibly gentle and melts away makeup while leaving my skin soft, hydrated, and comfortable. The creamy texture and soothing botanical scent make cleansing feel like a calming, luxurious step in my routine.

I really wanted to love this cleanser because it feels and smells good but it does not wash off with water. I have white towels and there is makeup all over them. This needs to be tissued or washclothed off which is fine if that's your routine but I shower before bed and want a cleanser that removes my makeup. I'll continue to use it when I take a bath and can use a washcloth and take my time.
My favorite Clarin product. The cleanser is mild but removes makeup and dirt.

I already had a favorite Clarins cleanser but decided to try the Velvet Facial Milk Cleanser. I love it as well. It leaves your face feeling amazing- smooth and not dry. This has become my travel cleanser as the foaming cleanser doesn't travel well (too big a container and prefer not to take a pump on a plane). It really is a treat to have such a beautiful product while traveling to beautiful places.

This is the best milky cleanser I've ever used. It quickly loosens makeup and does not irritate my eyes. I apply this cleanser with my hands and tissue the makeup off. I follow with a warm wash cloth which leaves my skin soft and refreshed. Highly recommend 👌 👍.

I didn't expect to love a cleanser this much, but here we are ✨ Clarins Velvet Facial Milk Cleanser is such a comfort product. It's super gentle, creamy, and just melts away makeup without stripping the skin. My face feels clean but still soft and hydrated after... no tightness at all!!! Perfect for days when your skin needs something calm and nourishing. It just feels..nice. Like a little skincare hug 🤍
It is a nice one but not my favorite of the Clarins cleansers

I received this as a small sample and when I ran out of it I started to freak out I was able to get this in a bundle and went around out of that one I started freaking out again so I'm very happy that they have the jumbo I received this as a small sample and when I ran out of it I started to freak out I was able to get this in a bundle and when I run out of that one I started freaking out again so I'm very happy that they have the jumbo size don't have to run out again and I also got the refill

This is my favorite make up remover at the end of my day. I apply it to my fave and wipe it off with cotton pads, then use face wash and do the rest of my night routine. Helps to keep my skin smooth and clean without stripping the natural oils.
Good for hydrating dry skin, helped keep my skin hydrated throughout the winter

I started using this it's after microneedling at home; I had a sample that I hadn't tried yet, but I'm so glad I did! Because this is so smooth and gentle with no strong scents or ingredients it's a perfect cleanser to use post MN! It's creamy and dreamy 🩶
Love this cleansing lotion. So gentle on the skin. Perfection.

I love this cleanser. You really don't need a heavy cleanser for the morning if you cleansed and moisturized properly the night before. But I like to use it in the morning after my workout. You only need about a dimes worth to cleanse the whole face and neck. It leaves my skin silky smooth and glowing. I also purchased a travel size so I will always have it with me.
I have been using Clarins products for many years now and love the products. This cleanser is gentle on my skin, smells nice and the skin feels clean without being stripped afterwards. Great product!

avis.titre: Really gentle cleaning with spa like smell
avis.texte: This cleanser is really great for the girlies that like a suds free type of wash! It also does a nice job at removing eye makeup. Plus the smell is very relaxing so you really look forward to your skin cleansing rituals!
Very gentle and has a light botanical type smell. It has a milk texture and somehow that doesn't leave residue or make me feel greasy or break out. I love it!

Second time purchasing this cleanser. As I've aged my skin can't tolerate many cleansers as they leave my skin too dry. This cleanser leaves my skin feeling soft and not at all dried out. It has a nice fragrance and goes on smooth and leaves my skin feeling clean. I recommend and will continue to repurchase when needed.

This will forever be a staple in my skincare routine. The formula is a gentle cleanser that removes my makeup and my skin feels fresh. it does not cause me to break out. And i noticed that my skin does not feel dry this winter as it would with other brands of skincare. It also goes a long way and lasts quite a while.

I have never used a milky toner/cleanser that works so well! I LOVE it. It not only works as a double cleanser but it leaves skin feeling soft and clean. The scent is gentle and pleasant, like all Clarins products. I think I'll be a fan of this for life! So happy I tried it.
This is a lovely cleanser. Super gentle on sensitive skin and leaves your skin soft and refreshes. Your skin feels pampered when you use this product.
Love how my skin feels after using the milk cleanser, but disappointed that it doesn't remove my mascara.

When they say velvet, they truly mean velvet. The Clarins Velvet Facial Milk Cleanser is exactly that; milky, soft, comforting, and incredibly gentle. It cleanses the skin thoroughly without stripping, leaving it feeling hydrated, supple, and perfectly softened. It doesn't form a lather, so don't expect it; it's just a creamy cleanser. This cleanser removes makeup with ease and works beautifully for both single and double cleansing routines. As with all Clarins products, the scent is absolutely heavenly and adds to the overall luxe, spa-like experience. While it's suitable for all skin types, I think dry, dehydrated, and sensitive skin will benefit the most from this soothing, nourishing formula. A perfect everyday cleanser when your skin needs comfort without compromise.
I've been using this cleanser for many years and it never disappoints. Leaves my skin so soft and moisturized. It is the best! Please never take it away!,,
I have used this product for over 40years and nothing is as gentle or effective.
I have sedative skin and this cleansing milk leaves my skin clean, fresh and never irritated or dry.
I have been using this product for years and love it! I have tried others and would not change it for the world.
The best facial cleanser above all, any brand out there! I've been using this since my 21st birthday- that's a few decades ago! Makes for a beautiful moisture mask too!
Not good with waterproof eyeliner and mascara. Some ingredient not good for sensitive skin. I felt burn after use.

avis.titre: Good but not what it used to be
avis.texte: I used Alpine Herb milk cleanser years ago it was greenish in color, but they discontinued it so I switched face brands completely. I recently decided it would be nice to just get my face wash along with all my other products so I tried this new version of a milk cleanser. The smell is nice. It feels nice on my skin. The only thing I don't like is that it's thinner than it used to be, so it runs right off your hand. Honestly don't think I'll buy it again just because of that but overall not a bad product.
Very gentle, hydrating, and non-irritating. Try it! I think you will find it worth the price and the wait.
Ever since Estee Lauder discontinued their milk wash, and then I discovered Clarins in Paris in 1983, this is my go to cleanser. It has kept my face soft and youthful throughout the ages.

avis.titre: Terrible smell and doesn't cleanse at all
avis.texte: Terrible smell…gave me a terrible headache. Didn't cleanse at all! My skin was oily and dirty after using. Put toner on with cotton pad after using and it was covered in leftover dirt.
Love this cleansing milk for my sensitive skin. Feels lovely on face.
I love this face cleanser. It is easy to use and it works great for my dry skin.
I have been using this cleanser for a couple years now and I absolutely love it.

I repurchased this cleanser after not using it for almost a year. I didn't realize how much I missed it. My skin is cleaner, smoother, glowing and feels so hydrated. It helped to reduce small pumps on my face caused my menopause. This is my holy grail. Highly recommend this.
Excellent product. I love it, I will purchase again, using this product last 6 years
This face cleanser is so silky, it easily removes heavy makeup and leaves your skin soft and hydrated.
I have been using this product for years. I have sensitive skin and this product has always worked well for me..

I've been a diehard fan of the cleansing milks for over 20 years. Loved the green one that was for dry skin and was sad they discontinued it. Finally needed to order again and tried this new version. I was pleasantly surprised with how much better this one is. Doesn't have the same smell as the original, which I really liked, but doesn't smell bad. continued it. This newer version is thicker and creamier. My skin was super soft after using and it rinsed well. This works for my dry skin.
I bought this and I really like this. It is so soft and smooth .
This cleanser is amazing! It leaves my face feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed.

Absolutely love to use this on days I need to wash when I don't wear makeup and every morning to start my day. I am 50 and having a hard time finding a wash that doesn't leave my face feeling stripped of everything. It always make my face feel soft and ready for serum!
My face is tricky, most cleansers leave my skin dry as sandpaper, so I was elated to find this!

avis.titre: Lovely customer service experience and the product
avis.texte: Lovely customer service experience and the products are so soothing
This facial milk cleanser is perfect for me. I love how gentle and creamy it is. Thank you for a wonderful product!

Best EVER facial creamy milky cleanser out there!!! Smells amazing (light fragrance) and takes off all makeup with ease! Non irritating! I cannot say enough great things about this cleanser! A little bit goes a LONG way!!! I'm tired of the foamy ones that burn your eyes; the ones that require you to add water to get the product working, etc….this is my cleanser from here on out!!

avis.titre: Did not know it's an exfoliating/Caused bad skin reaction
avis.texte: I wasn't aware that this was an exfoliating product. It is advertised as a gentle milky cleanser for sensitive skin not an exfoliant. On the 4th day using this I had a severe allergic reaction. My eyes were so puffy, and I didn't even use to remove eye makeup. My skin has welts and is so red an itchy and painful. If your skin is sensitive do not buy. Also, it should specifically say on the bottle that it is a chemical exfoliant. There is Citric acid listed.

I've been using Clarins cleanser, toner, serum and masks for decades. The cleanser is non drying which my skin needs at this point in my life. It's a clean brand because it's made in France. I've tried a lot Clarins products and so many of them are winners in my opinion.
This cleanser is so silky, completely cleans and nourishes my skin.

avis.titre: Cleansing milk as it should be
avis.texte: I'm very happy I found this product after some tiresome research for a "traditional" milk. It's gentle, hydrating and perfect for winter days.

avis.titre: Effective at makeup removal yet hydrating

Best skin cleanser. Cleans without stripping my skin. I always go back to this cleanser as it resets my skin and leaves it nice and supple.
Love this product. My skin feels refreshed, clean and soft. All makeup comes off with no effort.
Love this product. Love everything about it. Smell is divine and love how gentle it is on my skin.

I have been using this product for at least 25 to 35 years. It always delivers. It keeps my face fresh and young and soft. My skin is uber dry.

This cleansing milk cleans off make-up and daily dirt with a tissue and never leaves an icky film or causes breakouts. I so love it. Feels gentle, clean and moisturizing.
Love this product. I use it at night as part of cleaning my face.

avis.titre: A must have for any skin type.
avis.texte: I love how gentle this product cleanses, leaving my face feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated.
So silky smooth that leaves your face feeling the same! The smell is fresh and clean. I will continue to buy this over and over!
This cleanser is my go to everyday. This cleansing milk keeps my face smooth and does not dry out my skin.

avis.titre: Wonderful cleanser, you get the "spa" feeling
avis.texte: I alternate this cleanser with the "huile" cleanser. I love the feeling of my skin when I use these products.

I am a loyal customer of Clarins for over 30 years. I love ALL of your products and the only skincare products I have used in these 30 plus years. My complaint is not the product "Velvet Cleansing Milk" but the new container.—the top will not snap closed. The blue milk cleanser that I used for years had a screw on top—no problem. I have been trying to snap it closed for 5 minutes now and I have given up. This was true of the bottle I just finished. I was smart enough to have bought bottles of the blue milk cleaner so I didn't know the new one would be SUCH A PAIN!!! It's sooooo frustrating! Please use the original container. It's not worth the few pennies you might be saving. Your products are excellent. Please don't lower your standards by using cheap and inferior storage containers. Knowing your standards of excellence and customer satisfaction, I am confident that this matter will be addressed..

Love this cleanser. First time to try it! Having very dry skin all my life, I am always trying cleansers that don't dry my face out! I think I have found my cleanser! It is nice and creamy and feels great on your face after washing it off. It even takes your mascara off also without burning your eyes! I think the price is very reasonable especially when you get it on sale!
This cleanser is so gentle but does a great job of getting makeup off

I love using this cleanser. For one, it really does clean and take a tone of crap off your face. It takes off my full face of makeup while also cleaning my skin at the same time. After washing my face with it, my skin is so soft and smooth. I've seen a huge improvement in my skins texture and tone after using this.
